ITEM 1 | Dense pile of dark green, ruffled leaves with lobed, serrated edges and thin pale stems, glossy and slightly wet with a light dressing sheen, covering roughly 40-45% of a white square plate and standing about 2-3 cm high at its thickest; leaves are soft and limp, holding a loose mound shape, with a few thin stalks extending outward to the right edge | 90
ITEM 2 | Small pale off-white to tan pieces, irregular and crumbly, about 0.5-1 cm each, scattered among and under the greens; some show light golden-brown edges suggesting toasting or light browning, with a slightly rough, grainy surface | 15
ITEM 3 | Thin, glossy, semi-translucent dressing or oil film pooled lightly on the plate beneath and around the greens, with a reddish-brown tint at the edges, visible as a faint sheen on the white plate surface | 8
ITEM 4 | Several tiny crumbs and specks of light brown to orange-tan material scattered on the white plate to the right of the greens, each under 0.5 cm, dry and crumbly in appearance | 2
